title: The GARP-ARR-B family transcription factor SeAPRR2 positively regulates drought tolerance in chayote (Sechium edule).
authors: Cheng, Shaobo; Chen, Zhili; Yan, Wei; Su, Lihong; Zhou, Xiaoting; He, Zhongqun
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定并研究转录因子SeAPRR2在干旱胁迫中的功能，虽涉及TF-DNA结合验证（DAP-seq/Y1H），但核心是植物抗逆生理与基因功能，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Chayote, an economically vital cucurbit crop, faces severe production and quality constraints due to increasing drought stress. Despite this threat, systematic identification and analysis of the GARP-ARR-B transcription factor family in chayote remain unreported. This study identified 11 ARR-B transcription factors in chayote, with focused investigation on the drought-responsive gene SeAPRR2. SeAPRR2 exhibited rapid induction under PEG-simulated drought, and its heterologous expression significantly enhanced osmotic stress tolerance in yeast. Furthermore, SeAPRR2 overexpression in tomato substantially improved drought resistance, manifested through reduced wilting, decreased electrolyte leakage, lower malondialdehyde content, elevated proline accumulation, attenuated reactive oxygen species (ROS), and accelerated stomatal closure. The interaction between SeAPRR2 and the metallochaperone SeHIPP3 was confirmed by Y2H, LCI, BIFC and molecular docking. Additionally, DAP-seq, Y1H, and LUC assays demonstrated SeAPRR2's direct binding and transcriptional activation of SeP5CS1 and SeNCED5. Collectively, SeAPRR2 synchronously enhances drought tolerance through proline-mediated osmotic adjustment and ABA-triggered stomatal closure, suggesting its potential as a candidate gene for enhancing drought tolerance in chayote germplasm.
abstract_zh: 佛手瓜作为一种经济上至关重要的葫芦科作物，因日益加剧的干旱胁迫而面临严重的产量和品质限制。尽管存在这一威胁，佛手瓜中GARP-ARR-B转录因子家族的系统鉴定和分析仍未见报道。本研究在佛手瓜中鉴定出11个ARR-B转录因子，并重点研究了干旱响应基因SeAPRR2。SeAPRR2在PEG模拟干旱条件下表现出快速诱导表达，其异源表达显著增强了酵母的渗透胁迫耐受性。此外，SeAPRR2在番茄中的过表达显著提高了抗旱性，表现为萎蔫减轻、电解质渗漏减少、丙二醛含量降低、脯氨酸积累增加、活性氧（ROS）减弱以及气孔关闭加速。通过Y2H、LCI、BIFC和分子对接实验证实了SeAPRR2与金属伴侣蛋白SeHIPP3之间的相互作用。此外，DAP-seq、Y1H和LUC实验表明，SeAPRR2直接结合并转录激活SeP5CS1和SeNCED5。综上，SeAPRR2通过脯氨酸介导的渗透调节和ABA触发的气孔关闭同步增强抗旱性，表明其作为增强佛手瓜种质抗旱性的候选基因具有潜力。
